description: This file defines syntax highlighting mode for Haskell language in CodeMirror editor, including tokenization rules, keyword definitions, and comment handling.

methods.name: switchState
methods.description: Handles state switching during tokenization, especially for nested comments and string literals.

methods.name: normal
methods.description: Main tokenizer function for normal code, handling whitespace, comments, strings, identifiers, numbers, and symbols.

methods.name: ncomment
methods.description: Tokenizer for nested comments, managing comment nesting levels.

methods.name: stringLiteral
methods.description: Tokenizer for string literals, handling escape sequences and string termination.

methods.name: stringGap
methods.description: Handles line continuation within string literals.
